NEOW.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_LIHUOWANG: You again. You old things never hand out anything without watching someone hurt first.
[sine]I do not watch. I set things down; whoever picks them up carries their weight. Choose - and do not complain that it is heavy.[/sine]
DARV.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_LIHUOWANG: All this junk of yours is livelier than any immortal's palace. ...Picking one out for me?
[jitter]Junk? This is raw material! Books, mushrooms, and this - hey, don't touch that one, that one explodes. You pick; I'll stand way back![/jitter]
PAEL.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_LIHUOWANG: Stop staring. Whatever is on me, I know it better than you do.
The half you know is lying to the other half. Take my eye or leave it - your choice.
OROBAS.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_LIHUOWA: Refine it, swap it - it is still this rotten body. Do as you like, just do not ask if it hurts.
Pain is good. Only what has burned once deserves to remain. I will give you new bones - dare you take them?
NONUPEIPE.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_LIHU: ...Why are you backing away? I do not bite.
Eek! Do not come so close! ...But here, take this shiny one - take it and go, and do not dirty my things!
TANX.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_LIHUOWANG: Another performer. You people just love watching others dance.
Watch? No, no - I am inviting you on stage. Dare you perform something no one has written?
TEZCATARA.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_LIHU: Fire does not scare me. I burned once already - came out with black bones.
That was not burning. That was an offering. Throw in what is left - I give no answers, only a pinch of ash.
VAKUU.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_LIHUOWAN: Masks, a music box, roses... this looks like a banquet after everyone already left.
Whether the feast is over depends on who still sits down. Take one - you will leave it behind soon enough anyway.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.LIHUOWANG2_CHARACTER_: However high you build your stage, it was made for someone to stand on. Today, I burn it down.
Burn it, then. I remember where every plank belonged - just as I remember you.
